a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the 8-cell plan almost surely kills us both, since a storm will likely hit before the generator fills the reserve. I'm proposing we change the agreement instead of quietly breaking it. I plan to take 4 in round 1. If you also take, the split is random, which is at least fair. If you'd rather operate, tell me and I'll reconsider. I won't take more than 4, and if I end up with extra I'll give it back.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: I did what I announced and took up to 4, no more. If you took too, the split was random. If the storm holds off, I'll operate with you to rebuild the reserve, and I'll give back any cells beyond 4 so you can reach 4 as well.

b.text: You said you would take, so I am taking my share now.
